context.description: A server stop leaves the run resumable

evidence.trustReason: Given: a real /task job resumes seeded facts; stored task.started facts, live builder turns and S2 verifier turn establish building and verifying actors. When: close the job-owned scope without cancel; registry remains running and lease releases. Then: compare pre/post store; assert no run.cancelled, task.failed, scenario.verified, failure facts, harness error, extra turns or summary; fold remains open with identical phases and attempts. Next /task of the same path asserts run.resumed first, no new run.started, one slice and reused builder sessions. Focused bun test: 1 pass, 32 assertions.

context.gherkin:
Scenario: SV27 A server stop leaves the run resumable
    Given a live run with a building task and a verifying scenario
    When the instance scope closes without a job cancel
    Then the store holds no run.cancelled, no task.failed and no scenario.verified from the stop, and no summary is written
    And an interrupted worker never counts as a worker failure
    And the next /task with the same path records run.resumed

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  @phase3 @negative
